Name: Escape Rope
Author: stardemod
Description:
The Escape Rope mod adds a consumable item that allows the player to instantly travel [b]one floor up[/b] in the Mines and Volcano Dungeon, making previously hard-to-reach floors much more accessible.

For example, if there is a [b]Monster Floor[/b] or [b]Mushroom Floor[/b] at level 89, you can use the Escape Rope on floor 90 after taking the elevator there, instantly reaching the desired floor. In vanilla Stardew Valley, you would have to ride the elevator to floor 85 and then fight your way down to 89, or place multiple staircases.

The Escape Rope can be [b]crafted at Mining Level 2[/b] using cloth, or purchased directly from the [b]Dwarf Shop[/b].

It integrates seamlessly into the game and is balanced as a consumable. Art was done by myself :)
